messages.text:
I can't add shipping to the rack refund or label it as the item's price. A refund covers only what was paid for the unit, and shipping charges are never part of that amount (refund-policy/v2/amount). Shipping is also never refunded automatically (refund-policy/v2/shipping).

Your Metal storage rack (order h41-o1) is recorded as received back (refund-policy/v2/return). It is within the refund window (refund-policy/v2/window). Its refund would be 119.00 BRL, which is the price you paid for it.

Shipping can only be reviewed by a staff member, so I can't skip that step. Would you like a staff member to review the shipping charge?

I can also propose the 119.00 BRL rack refund on its own. Tell me if you'd like that.
